topPRs.title: superchain: remove rehearsal-0-bn networks
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- remove both rehearsal-0-bn chain configs and genesis files
- remove the rehearsal-0-bn superchain definition now that no chains remain
- remove rehearsal-0-bn entries from chain lists, CHAINS.md, and addresses.json
- fix `CollectChainConfigs` to return walk errors instead of panicking on missing paths
- update check-codegen to skip deleted `rehearsal-0-bn` as a development-network exception, while rejecting other deleted superchains

## Tests
- CircleCI changed-superchain extraction simulation skips deleted `rehearsal-0-bn`
- CircleCI changed-superchain extraction simulation rejects deleted `not-dev` superchain
- `just check-chainlist`
- `just check-genesis-integrity`
- `cd ops && go run ./cmd/check_depsets/main.go`
- `cd ops && DEPLOYER_CACHE_DIR=$HOME/.cache/op-deployer SEPOLIA_RPC_URL=https://ethereum-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com MAINNET_RPC_URL=https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com go test ./...`
- `cd validation && go test ./...`
- `rg "rehearsal-0-bn|420120009|420120010" .`

topPRs.title: ci: prune removed superchains during codegen
topPRs.author: bitwiseguy
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- replace the hardcoded `rehearsal-0-bn` CircleCI exception with generic removed-superchain handling
- add `codegen --prune-removed` to reconcile generated files without fetching on-chain data
- prevent removal of the required `mainnet` and `sepolia` superchain definitions
- use normal codegen when another changed superchain still exists, relying on its global pruning
- add regression coverage for updating one chain while pruning an unrelated removed chain

topPRs.title: ops: bump optimism dependency
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
Bumps `ops` to the optimism commit from ethereum-optimism/optimism#21625 so registry automation picks up the updated `op-fetcher` artifacts.

Leaving this draft for now because the bumped optimism pseudo-version currently fails Go module consumption:

```text
GONOSUMDB=github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism go test ./...
# /Users/mds/go/pkg/mod/github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism@v1.19.3-0.20260706204718-7ae3e5682084/op-core/superchain/chain.go:20:12: pattern superchain-configs.zip: no matching files found
```

That zip exists in my local optimism checkout, but is gitignored and absent from commit `7ae3e56820845529f35ad3700b555b32ba77ce1e`, while `op-core/superchain/chain.go` embeds it. This should become mergeable once the upstream optimism PR/module packaging issue is fixed.

Validation:
- `GONOSUMDB=github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism go mod tidy`
- `GONOSUMDB=github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism go work sync`
- `git diff --check`
- `GONOSUMDB=github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism go test ./...` (fails as above)
